message: Use the latest ARM common-types version 'v6' instead of 'v5'.
Top-level resource 'Widget' should define a list by resource group operation.

The RP-specific property model in the 'properties' property of this resource must contain a 'provisioningState property.  The property type should be an enum or a union of string values, and it must specify known state values 'Succeeded', 'Failed', and 'Canceled'.
Tracked resource 'Widget' must have patch operation that at least supports the update of tags.
Union of literals should include the base scalar as a variant to make it an open enum. (ex: `union Choice { Yes: "yes", No: "no", string };`).
The UnionVariant named 'fast' should have a documentation or description, use doc comment /** */ to provide it.
The UnionVariant named 'safe' should have a documentation or description, use doc comment /** */ to provide it.
